content.src: 这是一个小城，说是小城其实只是一个大点的镇子，名字也叫青牛镇，只有那些住在附近山沟里、没啥见识的土人，才“青牛城”“青牛城”的叫个不停
content.target: This is a small town, though it's more like a large village called Qingniu Town. Only the locals from nearby valleys, who lack much worldly experience, keep calling it 'Qingniu City' over and over.

content.src: 这是干了十几年门丁张二的心里话
content.target: This is the honest thought of Zhang Er, who has been a gatekeeper for over ten years.

content.src: 青牛镇的确不大，主街道只有一条东西方向的青牛街，连客栈也只有一家青牛客栈，客栈坐落在长条形状的镇子的西端，所以过往的商客不想露宿野外的话，也只能住在这里
content.target: Qingniu Town is indeed small, with only one main street running east to west, called Qingniu Street. There's just one inn, the Qingniu Inn, located at the western end of the long, narrow town. So, passing merchants who don’t want to sleep outdoors have no choice but to stay here.

content.src: 现在有一辆一看就是赶了不少路的马车，从西边驶入青牛镇，飞快的驶过青牛客栈的大门前，停都不停，一直飞驰到镇子的另一端，春香酒楼的门口前，才停了下来
content.target: Now, a carriage that clearly had traveled a long way entered Qingniu Town from the west. It sped past the front of Qingniu Inn without stopping and raced all the way to the other end of the town, stopping only in front of Chunxiang Restaurant.

content.src: 春香酒楼不算大，甚至还有些陈旧，但却有一种古色古香的韵味
content.target: Chunxiang Restaurant isn’t very big and even looks a bit old, but it has a charming, antique feel.

content.src: 因为现在正是午饭时分，酒楼里用饭的客人还很多，几乎称的上是座无虚席
content.target: Since it was lunchtime, the restaurant was packed with customers, almost every seat taken.

content.src: 从车上下来一个圆脸带着小胡子的胖男子和一个皮肤黝黑的、十来岁的小孩，男子带着孩童直接就大摇大摆地进了酒楼
content.target: A round-faced, mustached man and a dark-skinned boy around ten years old stepped out of the carriage. The man swaggered into the restaurant with the child.

content.src: 有酒楼里的熟客认得胖子，知道他是这个酒楼的掌柜“韩胖子”，那个小孩是谁却无人认得
content.target: Some regulars recognized the man as 'Fatty Han,' the owner of the restaurant, but no one knew who the boy was.

content.src: “老韩，这个黑小子长的和你很像，不会是你背着家里婆娘生的儿子吧
content.target: "Old Han, this dark kid looks a lot like you. Could he be your secret son, born behind your wife’s back?"

content.src: ”有个人突然打趣道
content.target: Someone suddenly joked.

content.src: 这句话一出，惹的旁边的众人人哈哈一阵大笑
content.target: As soon as these words were spoken, they caused everyone nearby to burst into laughter.

content.src: “呸
content.target: "Ugh

content.src: 这是我本家带来的亲侄子，当然和我有几分像了
content.target: "This is my own nephew brought by my family, of course he looks a bit like me."

content.src: ”胖子不但没生气，还有几分得意
content.target: "Not only was the fat man not angry, but he also seemed a bit proud."

content.src: 这二人正是一连赶了三天路，才刚进镇子的韩立和他的三叔别人口中的“韩胖子”
content.target: "These two were none other than Han Li and his third uncle, whom others called 'Fatty Han,' who had just arrived in town after traveling for three days straight."

content.src: 韩胖子招呼了几位熟客一声，便把韩立带到酒楼后面，来到了一个偏僻小院子里
content.target: "Fatty Han greeted a few regular customers and then took Han Li to the back of the tavern, arriving at a secluded small courtyard."

content.src: “小立，你在这屋里好好休息下，养好精神，等内门的管事一来，我就叫你过去，我要先出去一下，招呼几位熟客
content.target: "'Xiao Li, rest well in this room and regain your energy. When the inner sect manager arrives, I’ll call you over. I need to step out first to attend to some regular customers.'"

content.src: ”韩胖子指着院里的厢房，和蔼的对他说道
content.target: "Fatty Han pointed to the side room in the courtyard and said kindly to him."

content.src: 说完，便转身匆忙地向外走去
content.target: "After speaking, he turned and hurried out."

content.src: 到门口时，他似乎心里又有些不太放心，又嘱咐了一句
content.target: "At the door, he seemed a bit uneasy and added another reminder."

content.src: “别乱跑啊，镇子里人太多，别走丢了，最好别出院子
content.target: "Don't run around. There are too many people in the town. Don't get lost. It's best not to leave the yard."

""

"Mm-hmm."

content.src:
”

看到韩立老实的答应了一声，他才真正放心的走了出去
content.target:
""

Seeing Han Li obediently agree, he finally felt at ease and walked out.

content.src: 韩立见到三叔走出了屋子，感到很累，便一头倒到床上呼呼的睡了起来，竟然没有一点小孩子怕生的感觉
content.target: After seeing his uncle leave the room, Han Li felt very tired and immediately fell asleep on the bed, showing no sign of shyness as a child usually would.

content.src: 到晚上，有个小厮送来了饭菜，虽然不是大鱼大肉，倒也算是可口
content.target: In the evening, a servant brought some food. Although it wasn't fancy, it was quite tasty.

content.src: 吃完后，一小厮又走了进来，把吃剩饭碗给端了出去，这时三叔才不慌不忙的走了进来
content.target: After eating, another servant came in to take away the leftovers. Only then did his uncle walk in calmly.

content.src: “怎么样，饭菜还合你胃口吧，有些想家了吧
content.target: "How was the food? Did you like it? Feeling a bit homesick?"

content.src:
”

“恩，有点想了
content.target:
""

"Mm-hmm, a little."

content.src: ”韩立显的很乖巧
content.target: "" Han Li appeared very well-behaved.

content.src: 三叔看起来对韩立的回答很满意，紧接着和他聊起了一些家常便话，吹嘘一些自己经历过的趣人趣事
content.target: His uncle seemed pleased with Han Li's answer and then chatted with him about everyday things, boasting about some interesting people and events he had experienced.

content.src: 渐渐的，韩立没有了拘束感，和他也开始有说有笑起来
content.target: Gradually, Han Li lost his sense of restraint and began to chat and laugh with him.

content.src: 就这样，一连过了两天
content.target: Just like that, two days passed in a row.

content.src: 第三天，当韩立吃完晚饭，正等三叔来给他讲江湖故事时，又有一辆马车停到了酒楼门前
content.target: On the third day, when Han Li finished dinner and was waiting for his uncle to tell him stories about the martial world, another carriage stopped in front of the tavern.

content.src: 这辆马车通体被黑漆刷的乌黑亮，驾车的也是不常见的百里挑一的黄骠骏马，最惹人注意的是，在马车边框上插着一面锈着“玄”字的小三角黑旗，银字红边，自然的透着一股说不出的神秘色彩
content.target: The carriage was painted glossy black, and it was pulled by a rare, top-quality yellow steed. Most noticeable was a small black triangular flag on the carriage's frame, embroidered with the character 'Xuan' in silver and red edges, giving off a mysterious aura.

content.src: 看到这面小旗，凡是在这方圆数百里走动的江湖老手都知道，这片地方的两大霸主之一的“七玄门”，有重要人物驾临本地了
content.target: Seeing this flag, any experienced martial artist within hundreds of miles knew that an important figure from one of the region's two dominant forces—the 'Seven Mysteries Sect'—had arrived.

content.src: “七玄门”又叫“七绝门”，由二百年前赫赫有名的“七绝上人”所创立，曾一度雄霸镜州数十载，甚至还渗透过与镜州相近的数州，在整个越国也声名赫赫过
content.target: The 'Seven Mysteries Sect,' also known as the 'Seven Deadly Sect,' was founded two hundred years ago by the famous 'Seven Deadly Sage.' It once dominated Jingzhou for decades and even spread to neighboring regions, gaining great fame across the Yue Kingdom.

content.src: 但自从“七绝上人”病故后，“七玄门”势力就一落千丈，被其他门派联手挤出了镜州府镜州城
content.target: But after the 'Seven Deadly Sage' passed away, the sect's influence declined sharply, and it was forced out of Jingzhou City by rival factions.

content.src: 百年前，宗门被迫搬迁到镜州最偏僻的地方——仙霞山，从此在处生根落户，落为三流地方小势力
content.target: A century ago, the sect was forced to relocate to the most remote part of Jingzhou—Mount Immortal Mist—where it settled and became a minor local power.

content.src: 有句话说的好瘦死的骆驼比马大，七玄门毕竟曾经是个大门派，拥有的潜力还是非同小可
content.target: As the saying goes, 'A starved camel is still bigger than a horse.' The Seven Mysteries Sect was once a major faction, and its potential remained formidable.

content.src: 来到彩霞山这个地方，立刻便控制住包括“青牛镇”在内的十几个小城镇，拥有门下弟子三四千人，是本地名附其实的两大霸主之一
content.target: After moving to Mount Rainbow Mist, it quickly took control of over a dozen small towns, including 'Green Ox Town,' and had three to four thousand disciples, making it one of the two dominant forces in the area.

content.src: 本地唯一能和七玄门抗衡的另一股势力是“野狼帮”
content.target: The only other local force that can rival the Seven Mysteries Sect is the 'Wild Wolf Gang'.

content.src: 野狼帮前身是镜州界内一股烧杀掳掠的马贼，后来几经官府围剿，一部分接受了官府招安，另一部分马贼便成了野狼帮，但是马贼凶狠嗜血、敢杀敢拼的狠劲却一并传了下来，因此七玄门在和野狼帮次冲突时屡屡处在了下风
content.target: The Wild Wolf Gang was originally a group of bandits in Jingzhou who robbed and killed. After several government crackdowns, some accepted the government's offer to surrender, while the rest became the Wild Wolf Gang. However, the gang inherited the bandits' fierce and bloodthirsty nature, making the Seven Mysteries Sect often lose in conflicts with them.

content.src: 野狼帮控制的乡镇虽然比较多，但不会经营，论富足程度远远及不上七玄门旗下的城镇
content.target: Although the Wild Wolf Gang controls more towns, they lack management skills, so their territories are far less prosperous than those under the Seven Mysteries Sect.

content.src: 野狼帮十分眼馋七玄门下的几个较富裕的地盘，最近经常挑起两者之间的冲突，这令现任的七玄门门主头疼不已，这也成为了七玄门近年来一再扩招门内弟子的主要原因
content.target: The Wild Wolf Gang is very envious of the wealthier areas under the Seven Mysteries Sect and has recently provoked frequent conflicts. This has troubled the current sect leader and is the main reason for the sect's recent expansion of disciples.

content.src: 马车上跳下一名四十多岁的瘦削汉子，这名汉子动作敏捷，明显身手不弱，对这里似乎也很熟悉，大踏步直奔韩理所在的屋子走去
content.target: A thin man in his forties jumped off the carriage. He moved quickly, clearly skilled, and seemed familiar with the place, walking straight toward Han Li's house.

content.src: 韩立三叔一见这人，立刻恭恭敬敬的上前施了一个礼
content.target: As soon as Han Li's uncle saw the man, he respectfully stepped forward and bowed.

content.src: “王护法，您老人家怎吗亲自带人来了
content.target: "Guardian Wang, why have you personally come to lead the team?"
"Hmph!"

content.src: ”王护法冷哼了一声，一脸的傲色
content.target: Guardian Wang snorted coldly, his face full of arrogance.

content.src: “这段时间路上不太平，要加强防卫，长老命我亲自来领人，废话少说，这个小孩就是你要推举的人
content.target: "The roads have been unsafe lately, so we must strengthen our defenses. The elder ordered me to personally fetch the recruits. Enough talk—is this child the one you're recommending?"

content.src:
”

“是的，是的，这是我本家的亲侄子，还望王护法路上多照应一下
content.target: "Yes, yes, this is my nephew from the same family. I hope Protector Wang can take care of him on the way."

content.src:
”

韩胖子看到这汉子神色有些不耐烦，麻利的从身上取出个沉甸甸的袋子隐秘的递了过去

王护法掂了掂袋子，神色有些缓松了下来
content.target: "Fat Han noticed the man looked impatient, so he quickly took out a heavy bag from his clothes and secretly handed it over. Protector Wang weighed the bag in his hand, and his expression softened a bit."

content.src: “韩胖子，你挺会做人吗
content.target: "Fat Han, you really know how to handle things."

content.src: 你侄子我路上自会照顾一二的，时间不早了，还是赶紧上路吧
content.target: "I’ll look after your nephew on the way. It’s getting late, we should start our journey soon."
